description: This file defines the LogWrapper class, which implements the LogNode interface to wrap Android's native Log utility, enabling logging with a chainable node structure.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A class that wraps Android's native Log utility to allow for flexible and chained logging.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode to which log data will be passed after this node processes it.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs the message to Android's log system, optionally appending a stack trace if an exception is provided, and passes the log to the next node if present.
